title: Interval Sweep
statement:
Sweep half-open integer intervals to find the peak number of overlapping intervals and the total length covered by at least one interval.

Input
n, followed by n lines of start end.

Output
Print peak overlap and covered length.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200000. Each integer interval obeys −10⁹ ≤ start < end ≤ 10⁹.
